questions.text: How many role recommendations are shown at once?
questions.reason: REQ-431 leaves this open. It sets the limit the api returns and the number of options the page renders.

questions.text: Is the list of job roles fixed or open?
options: Open - roles generated from the resume
questions.reason: REQ-431 leaves this open. A fixed list means a role catalogue and rule-based matching in the api; an open list means generating roles from the resume, which changes the design of the recommendation service.
